acceptanceCriteria: The pinning state of every MCP Git runner is confirmed from code and a test, and MCP-SERVER.md states it with that evidence.
If pinning is incomplete, the spec line is corrected instead.
body: Filed 2026-09-24 after the 0.8.0 release. docs/MCP-SERVER.md:165-169 says the inherited Git runners resolve git through PATH per invocation, post-start executable pinning is NOT_OBSERVED, and this is a known release blocker. docs/specs/mcp-server-2026-07-28-v0.md:492-493 says the CEM Git runner is pinned to the same start-time executable as the other kernels. Reported by the V1-0191 worker; the implementation state is not yet confirmed here.
title: docs: MCP-SERVER.md still calls Git executable pinning NOT_OBSERVED and a release blocker
